items.title: Richard Brunies Interview, 1959-04-27
items.q: There's another military band. Was it Brown's? Red Brown, yeah.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Before the First World War. Oh, yeah. Before the First World War. Before the First World War. Before the... I had a little stunt coming up. About the 1908's, huh? Grandma and I used to... His mother, I used to take... I was a walking stick. I used to take... She used to take me all around. I'd take all around. Oh, no. What else do you want?
